build_LinearLayer: build a LinearLayer module with configurable input size, output size, dropout, and activation function
build_FiLMLayer: build a FiLMLayer module that applies feature-wise linear modulation using scale and shift parameters
build_FiLMLinearLayer: build a FiLMLinearLayer module that combines FiLM modulation with a linear transformation layer
build_VariationalLayer: build a VariationalLayer module that samples from a learned distribution and computes KL divergence
build_CodebookLayer: build a CodebookLayer module that performs Gumbel-Softmax sampling or softmax over class embeddings
